short_description: ByteRogue is a minimalist turn-based puzzle-tactics roguelike where you play as a wizard-thief. Use spells to outsmart security robots, manipulate the environment, and steal as much treasure as you can in each daring heist.
steam_categories: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Full controller support; Custom Volume Controls; Keyboard Only Option; Playable without Timed Input; Steam Cloud; Family Sharing
